decision.summary: No new v005 rule configuration has positive net return before funding. The post-shock entry family is negative against the retained positive baseline; daily context does not establish a candidate.

scope.baseline_alias: BASELINE_V004 is the previously exposed STAGED_MACRO baseline; it is not a new v005 rule configuration

simulation_assumptions.return_basis: Account equity change net of modeled entry/exit costs, before funding; all filled positions are closed by the run end.
simulation_assumptions.drawdown_basis: maximum simulated event-path drawdown; not minute-marked drawdown

routed_entry_response.note: Each of six new profiles repeats the same 54 routed-decision/32-shock-cluster response cohort and exact response values; do not multiply the observations across profiles. The nominal one-day 95% CI is not multiplicity-adjusted and is not a selected-edge claim.

dependence_and_power.routed_entry_samples_by_branch_scope: Counts are separated by profile and by stage: routed decisions are not completed positions; the six new profiles share the same 54/32 decision cohort.
dependence_and_power.component_count_reference_note: 27 overlap components are fewer than the 30 effective-episode reference threshold, but component count is descriptive and is not a qualified effective independent N.

independent_review.production_source_and_executor_binding: the run executor JAR is bound by retained receipt and source hashes
independent_review.reconciliation_claim: All 14 serialized ledgers report zero ex-funding reconciliation difference; independent review audited account and fill traces within a tolerance below 1e-8 USDT.

known_limitations: Historical Binance archive vintages are retrospective; source hashes do not prove publication time. Coinalyze daily liquidation publication/revision timing is unqualified; the t+48h availability rule is a development assumption.
Daily-context warmup is missing 144 leading H1 hours in SOL, ZEC and TRX; missingness is preserved, and context does not carry across an incomplete day.
Contract sizes, fees, slippage, maintenance margin and liquidation fees are frozen approximations, not verified historical exchange metadata.
Inherited reversal logic does not latch a prior recovery-target/midpoint touch before the current confirmation bar; this ambiguity was preserved, not corrected or tested here.
Funding is excluded and is not treated as zero.
Hourly OHLC approximates execution and is also used as a trade-price mark proxy.
The 1% prior-hour base-volume capacity assumption is a proxy, not instantaneous liquidity.
Precommit statistical rejection gates, eight outer folds, and sealed or forward validation were not run; no profile is promoted.

daily_context_design.daily_bar: Same-asset UTC daily close from exactly 24 consecutive hourly bars; complete-day close is available at next UTC midnight. Missing/incomplete day is unknown with no carry.

rsi14.method: Wilder RSI-14 seeded from first 14 daily changes on 15 contiguous closes, then recursively smoothed; gap resets seed.

sma200.method: Arithmetic mean of the latest 200 contiguous completed UTC daily closes; gap resets warmup.

daily_context_design.stage2_gate: S&P 500 plus each enabled daily context must be neutral or supportive; unknown or opposing blocks only a new add.
daily_context_design.stage3_gate: S&P 500 plus each enabled daily context must be supportive.
daily_context_design.existing_positions: No context-triggered exit or stop change.
